title: Halloween Town
body:
Syntax: teleport halloween | teleport return | trickortreat

Halloween Town opens Monday through Sunday during the week of October 31 (Detroit time). Teleport halloween to a temporary 20-room festival (100000-100019); teleport return to leave, or be returned home automatically when the week ends. Visit the Costume Cauldron and Witch's Candy Cauldron to 'list' and 'buy' Ryo-based costume and candy stock. Wear costumes for permanent-equipment stat bonuses; use candy to heal and gain +10% mob XP for 15 minutes. Ordinary mob kills all across Nindo_mud have a 22% chance to drop Halloween candy during the event. At Mayor Jack Lantern's Porch, 'trickortreat' grants a daily treat or a surprise scarecrow. Undead genin, zombies, ghost ninja, vampire rogues, haunted jonin, and royal guards stand between the town and its final level-100 boss, The Pumpkin King. Defeat him for a 3.5% chance at The Pumpkin King's Cursed Mask: +175 Max Health, Chakra and Stamina, +5 Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence, +12 hitroll, +12 damroll. Costume and mask effects remain available year-round. Undead respawn in 7 minutes; the boss in 30. Event rooms and mobs are removed outside the holiday and excluded from save world.

Date: 2026-10-23
